user.description: If socket or serial communication is ready, press the local button to start. If IPARK Smart Home app is officially supported, additional features are provided through Smart Home integration. The new 'iPark Smarthome App' option works through the apartment complex's central server, the same way the official Android app does.

data_description.port: Port can be omitted for serial communication.

center.description: Please refer to the [documentation](https://github.com/dlxmax/ha-bestin-fork/blob/main/guide/center.md) for instructions on configuring each section.

data_description.ip_address: If elevator integration is required, please enter the IP address of the wall pad in the household.

iparkapp.description: Pick your apartment complex. The list is fetched from the i-parklife.com directory. Choose 'Enter manually' if your complex is missing.

iparkapp_manual.description: Enter the central server details manually. IP is required; the rest are optional.

iparkapp_login.description: Enter the same username and password you use in the iPark Smarthome app. No token copy-paste needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration is allowed.

error.directory_lookup_failed: Could not look up the site directory.

init.title: Adjust User Options
init.description: For the iPark Smarthome App option, the 'PWM mode' field enables slow software PWM control of ondol thermostats. See the [iPark Smarthome App guide](https://github.com/dlxmax/ha-bestin-fork/blob/main/guide/iparkapp.md#pwm-제어--pwm-control-신규--new) for details and recommended LPM valve settings.
